triples.source_text: The Lord said to me, “What do you see, Amos?” I said, “Adamant.” The Lord said to me, “Look, I am setting adamant in the midst of My people Israel. I will certainly no longer pass them by,

target_units.text: He said, “What do you see, Amos?” I said, “A fowler’s vessel.” The Lord said to me, “The end has arrived upon My people Israel. I will certainly no longer pass them by.

triples.relationship: same-book vision question and repeated judgment refrain
triples.rationale: Both visions ask Amos what he sees, receive his answer naming the object, and end with the Lord declaring that He will no longer pass His people by. The objects remain distinct: adamant in chapter 7 and a fowler's vessel in chapter 8.
